What every prompt in this library refuses to do

Every prompt here carries an explicit boundary on what the AI must not do, stated inside the prompt itself rather than left to the reader. Where a task could touch pricing, code compliance, permit requirements or a safety determination, the prompt forbids it in those words — that is every estimate prompt, every customer-facing prompt, and every prompt that reads a technician's account of a job. Prompts for purely internal tasks, such as reading a draft procedure back or cleaning up a voicemail transcript, carry the boundary relevant to that task instead of all four. The boundaries are not decoration. They are the difference between a useful drafting tool and a liability.
If you edit a prompt, keep its rules block. It is the part doing the safety work.
